title: Money Talks
tagline: A cross-chain chat app with a wallet that users can use to save/group-invest.
description: Through Money Talks, people can create Group Chats and invite anyone they like. Each group chat includes a wallet attached to it, where users can send tokens so that they can pool money and use it anywhere they like. They can also invest the tokens in DeFi protocols. User can do all the normal chat activities such as sending videos, pictures, etc.
how_its_made: In the project the group chats are made with Push Protocol, image upload functionality is done through web3.storage. The wallet attached to every chat is a Safe Wallet. The wallet funds can be invested in Spark Protocol. For Push and Safe integration as well as web3.storage, we used their SDKs and APIs. For Spark Protocol, the dApp interacts with their Pool smart contract.
